# Sheepdog Sim

A free sheep herding game in your browser. Play as a sheepdog in a golden-hour pasture and guide every sheep through the gate into the pen. Choose 25, 75 or 200 sheep; play solo, or co-op and shared-flock competitive with two to four players through invite links and regional public lobbies. Keyboard, gamepad and touch. No download or account. Open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later).

## Play

- [Play Sheepdog Sim](https://sheepdogsim.com/): The game. Choose a flock size, press Play and bring the whole flock into the pen.
- [25 sheep](https://sheepdogsim.com/play/25): Start a round with 25 sheep, the size to learn on.
- [75 sheep](https://sheepdogsim.com/play/75): Start a round with 75 sheep.
- [200 sheep](https://sheepdogsim.com/play/200): Start a round with 200 sheep.

## How to play

- [How to play and controls](https://sheepdogsim.com/support): Move with W A S D, the arrow keys, the left stick or the touch joystick; hold Shift, the right trigger, gamepad A or Sprint to sprint; press Space, gamepad B or X, or Bark to move nearby sheep; press C or gamepad Y to switch between the Classic and Follow cameras. Approach from behind the sheep relative to the gate and give them room to turn. Browser requirements and troubleshooting.
- [Herding guide](https://sheepdogsim.com/herding-guide): The rules the flock follows, with the game's own numbers: sheep run from a dog inside 8 meters, a bark reaches 40 meters in a cone with a 1.5 second cooldown, and sheep pressed from the far side are pulled toward the gate within 30 meters. Tips for 25, 75 and 200 sheep.
- [Multiplayer](https://sheepdogsim.com/multiplayer): Co-op and shared-flock competitive for 2 to 4 players. How to create a room, send an invite link and find public rooms by region. Each region hosts one room at a time for now.
- [About the game](https://sheepdogsim.com/about): One dog, one flock, one field. No time limit, no way to lose a sheep, no ads and nothing to buy. Personal bests are saved on your device, with optional online solo times. Needs JavaScript and WebGL2 or WebGPU.
- [Tentang game dalam bahasa Indonesia](https://sheepdogsim.com/id/): What the game is and how to play, in Indonesian.
- [Privacy](https://sheepdogsim.com/privacy): What the game stores locally, what online times and multiplayer history send, and how aggregate site analytics work.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/matthew-kissinger/sds): Simulation, renderer, input, audio, deterministic asset recipes and release tests, by Matthew Kissinger.
- [Issues](https://github.com/matthew-kissinger/sds/issues): Report a problem with the browser, device, flock size and steps to reproduce.

## Optional

- [Instrukt Labs](https://instruktlabs.com/): The lab that makes Sheepdog Sim; its farm assets were made with Kiln.
- [Sitemap](https://sheepdogsim.com/sitemap.xml)
